title: Kissed Herbal Venezuelan Falafel Bowl
description: A herbal and molten Venezuelan dish featuring falafel, made with a bain-marie and served in a Korean brass bowl, this recipe is FODMAP friendly and perfect for meal prep. It combines the flavors of Venezuela with the convenience of a bowl meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a food processor, combine chickpeas, parsley, cilantro, garlic infused oil, lemon juice, salt, black pepper, and korean chili flakes, and process until well combined.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small falafel balls.
Place the falafel balls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes, flipping halfway through.
While the falafel is baking, heat the olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add the cooked brown rice to the saucepan and stir to combine with the olive oil.
To assemble the bowls, place a portion of the brown rice mixture in the bottom of a Korean brass bowl, followed by a few falafel balls and some roasted vegetables.
